data.title: bn-3cs: Add touch haptics to the web console
data.description: Review commit 2827d43 for touch-only rising-edge browser haptics, safe Vibration API fallback, focused packed-page browser acceptance, and docs.

data.reason: LGTM. Commit 2827d43 correctly gates vibration to touch pointer rising edges, differentiates 12ms A/B from 8ms navigation and menu feedback, preserves aggregate multi-touch/slide input semantics, and isolates absent/throwing vibration implementations from input. Independent validation passed: node syntax checks, five repeated focused Chromium haptics runs, full Chromium browser-check, just check, diff check, and an additional two-finger action-plus-d-pad slide/release probe. Docs accurately describe the behavior and opt-in browser gate.
